SMTO-PRX-0004 — The Proxmox sign-in details are in the wrong form

GUID: c81a1200-ed8c-4f4a-98d1-d83ffcbe2f44
Slug: proxmox-auth-values-invalid
Domain: PRX · Subsystem: prx

What happened

  • The username or password given for your Proxmox server wasn't in a form SMTO can use, so SMTO didn't try to sign in. Nothing was sent to Proxmox.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. When SMTO asks for your Proxmox sign-in, enter the username with its realm, such as root@pam, not just root. Proxmox usernames must include the realm after an @ sign.
  2. If your Proxmox server is saved in Parameter Store, open it, find the saved Proxmox server, and correct the username there. SMTO uses the saved details unless you give it new ones.
  3. Give only a username and a password, with nothing else added. SMTO accepts just these two values for signing in to Proxmox.

What success looks like

  • SMTO signs in to Proxmox and the action continues.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages your Proxmox server. Don't send your password to anyone along with the error details.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Proxmox auth_values was rejected because it is not an object of only username and password strings, or the overlaid server profile failed typed validation (for example a username without a realm).

What this means

  • auth_values is not an object containing only username/password strings. Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.

Why this can happen

  • auth_values is not an object containing only username/password strings.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the supplied private auth field names/types with the supported username/password contract.

How to fix it

  • Pass auth_values as an object containing only string username and password fields; the username must be in user@realm form, such as root@pam. If the stored value is wrong, fix the Proxmox server_connection entry in Parameter Store; any other invalid field in that saved profile (such as port or scheme) also raises this error.
  • Correct the intended profile credential field types through the supported authentication flow.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Valid private authentication fields are accepted without entering public diagnostics.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
